tools.name: get_word_list
tools.description: The full list: every word, its groups (for example -at, -an, -ap families), the grade range, the placement basis, the page URL and the license. Use an id from list_word_lists, e.g. short-a, kindergarten, sh.

tools.name: get_words_for_grade
tools.description: Every different English word from the lists that cover a grade, deduplicated, with the lists each word comes from. tools.name: find_words
tools.description: Finds words in the lists that start with, end with or contain a letter pattern, for example 'sh', 'ck', '-ight' or 'ai'. Returns each match with its list, grade range and page. Case-insensitive.

tools.name: get_placement_basis
tools.description: Explains the source of each grade placement: Dolch's own grade levels (1936, public domain), the Common Core Foundational Skills item that names the skill, or a typical sequence when no standard names it. Includes the limits.

tools.name: get_citation
tools.description: License (CC BY 4.0 for the compilation; the Dolch words are public domain), the citation text and the CSV and JSON download addresses.
